title: Mayon Volcano Day158+ Pyroclastic Flow 4km
description: Mayon volcano produced its longest pyroclastic density current (PDC) since the magmatic eruption began, extending 4km on June 9. Over 287,000 people remain displaced. Alert Level 3 maintained with 6km Permanent Danger Zone. Rainy season lahar risk increasing significantly.
update_details: Longest PDC since magmatic eruption began (4km); 287,000+ displaced; AL3 maintained; 6km PDZ; rainy season lahar risk increasing

confidence_factors.notes: PHIVOLCS official monitoring; PNA official news agency report
